name: Sheep And Goat
source:
Gris is an honor roll sheep loved by everyone. Shaun is a slacking academic victim who fades into the background. The two boys walk home together and reflect on their day at school as well as their home lives. 

[From [url=https://soup-store.itch.io/sheep-and-goat]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
格里斯是一只受到大家喜爱的荣誉羊。肖恩是一个懒惰的学术受害者，逐渐淡出了人们的视线。两个男孩一起走回家，回顾他们在学校的一天以及他们的家庭生活。

[来自[url=https://soup-store.itch.io/sheep-and-goat]Itch.io[/url]]
